dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's this Pearl Galley you speak of?

dialogues.speaker: Pinghai
dialogues.text: Well, it's normal to not know.

dialogues.speaker: Pinghai
dialogues.text: The Pearl Galley is where the wealthy bigwigs of Liyue pass their time. It's no place for plebeians.

dialogues.speaker: Pinghai
dialogues.text: With the exception of honored guests, any ordinary person who goes onboard will just be there as an onlooker.

dialogues.speaker: Pinghai
dialogues.text: Well, I've said quite a bit, haven't I? If there's nothing else, don't waste any more of my time.
